scoped_obligations: Preserve the negation of Earth having rings.
basis: One negated property of Earth. Negation does not introduce a second proposition.

scoped_obligations: Preserve Venus as the subject, slowly as the rate description, opposite direction as the relation, and most planets as the comparison group.

alternatives.proposition: Venus spins slowly in the opposite direction from most planets.
alternatives.reading: One spinning predication with manner and directional qualifiers.

children: Venus spins slowly.
Venus spins in the opposite direction from most planets.
alternatives.reading: An independently evaluable spin-rate property and an independently evaluable spin-direction property.

basis: The asserted content is understood, but the guide does not specify when integrated manner and direction descriptions count as qualifiers of one predication versus additional independently asserted properties. These alternative atomizations preserve the text but select different classes. This is a guideline adjudication issue, not a factual uncertainty.

scoped_obligations: Preserve Mars' axis of rotation, the 25-degree value, the reference plane of its orbit, and the Sun as the orbital reference.
basis: One angular-tilt relation with its quantity and reference frame. The orbit and Sun identify the reference plane; they are not separately asserted events.

scoped_obligations: Preserve the superlative shortest and its solar-system comparison scope.
basis: One superlative day-length comparison. Other members of the comparison are arguments, not independently asserted facts.

scoped_obligations: The probe measured 12 kPa during 2024 in Ontario.
basis: One measurement event with a value, unit, time, and jurisdictional location. The time and place qualify that event.

scoped_obligations: Preserve the analyst as the comparing agent and the temperatures in Oslo and Rome as the two comparison arguments.
basis: One comparison event. The two temperature arguments are not separate assertions of their values.

children: Venus is the second planet from the Sun.
Venus is Earth's closest planetary neighbor.
scoped_obligations: Preserve the ordinal and solar reference in the first child and the closest-neighbor comparison with Earth in the second.
basis: The explicit coordination asserts two different relations of Venus. Neither relation is merely an argument or qualifier of the other.

children: Deimos is about half as big as Phobos.
Deimos orbits two and a half times farther away from Mars.
scoped_obligations: Preserve about half, Phobos as the stated size comparand, and the literal two and a half times farther away wording. The second comparative follows the Phobos comparison; do not convert farther into an unstated numerical distance formula.
basis: The coordinated predicates separately assert a size comparison and an orbital-distance comparison. The elliptical distance baseline is carried by the preceding comparison, while the original comparative wording is retained.

children: During part of the year, the northern hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun.
During part of the year, the southern hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun.
scoped_obligations: During part of the year has shared scope under the explicit leading-modifier rule. Preserve the opposite directions and recover the Sun as the elliptical reference of away. Do not add a planet from the source locator.
basis: Two hemispheric-tilt relations are asserted. The leading temporal modifier is shared by both under the controlled profile.

children: Earth's atmosphere affects Earth's long-term climate.
Earth's atmosphere affects Earth's short-term local weather.
Earth's atmosphere shields people on Earth from much of the harmful radiation coming from the Sun.
scoped_obligations: Use the supplied context for the atmosphere and us. Preserve long-term, short-term local, much of, harmful, and coming from the Sun on their respective children.
basis: The coordinated objects of affects assert two independently evaluable effects, and shields adds a third property. Authorized context resolves the atmosphere and us.

children: The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The auditor reported that the alarm sounded.
scoped_obligations: Both children remain attributed to the auditor. Neither the server stopping nor the alarm sounding is asserted as an unattributed fact. The coordinated complement is within the stated that-clause.
basis: The guide requires attribution over an explicit coordinated complement to remain on every child. That instruction adjudicates this complement as shared report scope.

children: In Ontario during 2024, the laboratory measured 12 kPa.
In Ontario during 2024, the operator recorded 4 kg.
scoped_obligations: The explicit leading Ontario and 2024 modifiers have shared scope. Preserve the distinct agents, actions, values, and units.
basis: Two coordinated events with different agents and quantities. The controlled shared-scope rule applies to the leading modifiers.

scoped_obligations: Do not select whether the alarm event is within the auditor report. Do not use the absence of that or punctuation to settle matrix scope.

children: The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The auditor reported that the alarm sounded.
The auditor reported that the server stopped.
The alarm sounded.
alternatives.scope: Only the server event is reported; the alarm event is directly asserted.

basis: Both a coordinated reported complement and a coordination of the report with an independent alarm assertion remain live. Their attribution differs materially.

scoped_obligations: Preserve Ontario without assigning its scope to one or both events.

children: The operator inspected the valve.
The engineer recorded the pressure in Ontario.
alternatives.scope: Ontario qualifies only the engineer recording the pressure.

children: The operator inspected the valve in Ontario.
The engineer recorded the pressure in Ontario.

basis: The trailing location phrase can have local or shared scope. The guideline expressly does not resolve trailing-adjunct scope by punctuation.

scoped_obligations: Preserve the technician as photographer and the researcher as the photographed person. Do not equate being with the camera with camera ownership.

alternatives.proposition: The technician used the camera to photograph the researcher.
alternatives.attachment: The camera phrase is the instrument of photographing.

alternatives.proposition: The technician photographed the researcher who was with the camera.
alternatives.attachment: The camera phrase identifies or qualifies the researcher; it does not specify the photographing instrument.

basis: The prepositional phrase has two material attachments, one to the photographic action and one to the researcher.

scoped_obligations: Preserve the technicians and operators as the arriving groups. The scope of old is not explicitly repeated or otherwise disambiguated.

children: The old technicians arrived.
The operators arrived.
The old technicians arrived.
The old operators arrived.

basis: The adjective is inside the coordinated noun phrase rather than an explicitly shared sentence-level modifier. Both local and distributed readings remain live. The guide leaves the boundary of explicit leading shared modifier insufficiently defined for attributive coordination, so this application has moderate confidence.

scoped_obligations: Preserve every researcher and a report. Do not assert a unique report or require different reports for different researchers.

alternatives.structure: For every researcher, there exists a report that that researcher reviewed.
alternatives.scope: The existential report can vary by researcher; a shared report is also allowed.

alternatives.structure: There exists a report that every researcher reviewed.
alternatives.scope: At least one common report has wide existential scope.

basis: Universal-first and existential-first scopes are materially different, and neither is settled by the supplied root.

scoped_obligations: Retain the telling attribution, the engineer as addressee, and had signed as the anterior signing description. Do not assert either signing as an unattributed fact.

alternatives.proposition: The operator told the engineer that the operator had signed the report.
The operator told the engineer that the engineer had signed the report.

basis: Authorized context supplies two women and no further referent. Either can be the antecedent of she, changing the attributed signer.

scoped_obligations: Conditional antecedent, not separately asserted: the Sun were as tall as a typical front door.
Conditional consequent, not separately asserted: Earth would be the size of a nickel. Preserve were and would.
basis: The if/would construction asserts a counterfactual size relation conditionally; flattening its two clauses would falsely assert their hypothetical sizes.

scoped_obligations: Conditional antecedent, not separately asserted: Earth were the size of a nickel.
Conditional consequent, not separately asserted: Mars would be about as big as a raspberry. Preserve about, were, and would.
basis: An explicit counterfactual conditional requiring antecedent/consequent roles, rather than independent conjunction children.

scoped_obligations: Conditional antecedent, not separately asserted: Earth were the size of a grape.
Conditional consequent, not separately asserted: Jupiter would be about as big as a basketball. Preserve about, were, and would.
basis: An explicit counterfactual conditional. Both size clauses remain under the conditional operator.

scoped_obligations: Use the supplied context: it is Phobos and the planet is Mars. Preserve slowly, the future will, the disjunction, and about 50 million years. Both alternatives require an operator beyond flat all_of; their disjuncts must not become independent assertions.

operands.proposition: Phobos is slowly moving towards Mars.

branches: Phobos will crash into Mars in about 50 million years.
Phobos will break apart in about 50 million years.

alternatives.temporal_scope: About 50 million years applies to both disjunctive future outcomes.

operands.proposition: Phobos is slowly moving towards Mars.

branches: Phobos will break apart in about 50 million years.

alternatives.temporal_scope: About 50 million years applies only to breaking apart; the crash time is unspecified.

basis: The root combines an asserted motion with a future disjunction. Its trailing time phrase has shared or local scope. The guide says punctuation alone cannot settle that scope and requires ambiguity to remain the class when ambiguity and unsupported flat representation coexist.

scoped_obligations: Disjunctive branches, not separately asserted: the valve is open; the pump is running. Preserve or without adding an exclusive-or condition.
basis: A sufficiently understood disjunction. It does not assert that each branch holds.

scoped_obligations: Negation has scope over all_of(the server stopped, the alarm sounded). Neither event nor either individual event negation is independently asserted.
basis: The matrix not true scopes over the composite complement. It denies their conjunction, rather than asserting two separately negated events.
